badge: NATIONAL MOVEMENT UNITING PEOPLE - UNITING FOR A CAUSE
subheading: The Constitution belongs to the people of India and is the supreme law of the land and the foundation of our democratic Republic. It guarantees justice, liberty, equality and fraternity, protects fundamental rights, establishes the rule of law and provides the constitutional framework for democracy, secularism and federal governance. Its preservation is our shared responsibility.

card.description: A citizen-led constitutional rights movement dedicated to protecting democracy, secularism, equality, and the rule of law across the country.
